preconditions.description: The number of steps n is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.
The length of the string s is equal to the number of steps n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'UD' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string s is either 'U' or 'D'.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(x.isdigit() or x == '-1' for x in return_value.split())
postconditions.description: Each number in the output is either a digit or '-1'.

postconditions.expression: all(int(x) >= 1 or x == '-1' for x in return_value.split())
postconditions.description: Each number in the output is either '-1' or a positive integer.
